NO TEMPLATES. NO AI-GENERATED PLANS. A REAL COACH.

It has never been easier to get a workout plan. Ask an AI chatbot or download an app and you will have one in 30 seconds. That is exactly the problem. A plan generated in 30 seconds does not know your bad knee, your 60-hour work week, or why the last three programs did not stick, and it will not notice when you quietly stop showing up.

Every Transform online program is written by your coach, a real person, based on your call, your check-ins, and how your body is actually responding. When something is not working, your plan changes that week. You are paying for a coach, and a coach is what you get.

What you get Apps, templates and AI plans Transform online coaching

Accountability Push notifications Daily check-ins from a real person

When life gets in the way You fall off Your coach adjusts the plan

Does coaching from a distance actually work?

Yes, when a real person is coaching you. A two-year weight loss study published in the New England Journal of Medicine followed 415 adults. The group coached remotely was still down about 10 pounds two years later, close to the group coached face to face. The group left to do it on their own lost under 2 pounds. The difference was not whether people sat in the same room as their coach. It was whether a real person was coaching them at all.

In a city like Chicago, personal trainers charge roughly $60 to $120 an hour, and most people see their trainer for exactly that hour. Two sessions a week runs $120 to $240, and your coach disappears the moment it ends. We put those numbers in writing in our 2026 Chicago pricing guide.

WHY SOME CLIENTS CHOOSE ONLINE OVER THE STUDIO

  • Your schedule, not ours. Train at 5am, at 10pm, or on your lunch break. There is no appointment to move when work blows up.
  • It travels with you. Business trips, vacations and holidays stop resetting your progress, because your coach adjusts the plan to wherever you are.
  • Coaching for the other 165 hours. You train two or three hours a week. Your coach is there for the rest of it, which is where results are actually won or lost.
  • You learn to do it yourself. You finish knowing how to train and eat on your own, not just how to follow a trainer around a studio.
  • You can live anywhere in the US. Your coach does not need to be in your city.

When the studio is the better choice

If you want a coach standing next to you correcting every rep, or you know you need a scheduled appointment to show up at all, in-person training is hard to beat. If you are near Lakeview, come try the studio, where your first session is free. Plenty of people do both: studio sessions as the anchor, online coaching carrying the weeks they are away.

ONLINE COACHING FAQ

How much does online personal training cost?

Programs start at $127 per week, billed every four weeks. Your exact price depends on how much support you need, and we go over it on your free coaching call before you commit to anything.

How is this different from a fitness app or an AI-generated plan?

An app hands you workouts. We give you a coach. A real person writes your program, checks in with you every day, meets you on video every week, and changes the plan when your life changes. Nothing about your program is auto-generated.

Do I need a gym?

No. Your coach builds your program around what you actually have, whether that is a full gym, a few dumbbells at home, or just your body weight and a hotel room.

What happens on the weekly video call?

You and your coach meet one on one, review how the week went, talk through what is working and what is not, and update your plan for the week ahead. It is a live call, not a recording.

Will my coach know if my form is off?

Every exercise in your program comes with a video demo, and you can send your coach a video of any lift for feedback whenever you want a second set of eyes.

Do you offer online weight loss coaching?

Yes. Most of our online clients come to us to lose weight and keep it off, which is why nutrition coaching and daily accountability are built into every program instead of sold as add-ons.

What if I travel a lot?

That is one of the best reasons to train online. Your coach adjusts your plan for whatever gym, hotel or living room you are in that week, so travel stops resetting your progress.

Can I combine online coaching with studio training?

Yes. If you are in Chicago, plenty of clients use studio sessions as their anchor and online coaching to carry the travel weeks and the days they cannot get in.

Is there a contract?

No. You can stop anytime. We will ask you to plan on giving it 90 days, because that is how long it takes to see the kind of change you came for.

Where do you coach clients?

Anywhere in the United States. Our studio is in Lakeview, Chicago, and our online coaching is not limited by your zip code.
